154: newTalent{
155: 	name = "Dirge of Pestilence",
156: 	type = {"celestial/dirges", 1},
157: 	points = 5,
158: 	no_energy = true,
159: 	cooldown = 12,
160: 	sustain_slots = 'fallen_celestial_dirge',
161: 	mode = "sustained",
162: 	getShield = function(self, t) return self:combatTalentScale(t, 50, 200, 0.75) end,
163: 	getShieldCD = function(self, t) return 5 end,
164: 	callbackOnTemporaryEffectAdd = function(self, t, eff_id, e_def, eff)
165: 		if not self:hasEffect(self.EFF_NO_PESTILENCE) then
166: 			if e_def.status == "detrimental" and e_def.type ~= "other" and eff.src ~= self then
167: 				self:setEffect(self.EFF_NO_PESTILENCE, t.getShieldCD(self, t), {src=self})
168: 				if self:hasEffect(self.EFF_DAMAGE_SHIELD) then
169: 					local shield = self:hasEffect(self.EFF_DAMAGE_SHIELD)
170: 					local shield_power = self:spellCrit(t.getShield(self, t))
171: 					
172: 					shield.power = shield.power + shield_power
173: 					self.damage_shield_absorb = self.damage_shield_absorb + shield_power
174: 					self.damage_shield_absorb_max = self.damage_shield_absorb_max + shield_power
175: 					shield.dur = math.max(eff.dur, shield.dur)
176: 				else
177: 					self:setEffect(self.EFF_DAMAGE_SHIELD, eff.dur, {color={0xff/255, 0x3b/255, 0x3f/255}, power=self:spellCrit(t.getShield(self, t))})
178: 				end
179: 			end
180: 		end
181: 	end,
182: 	activate = function(self, t)      
183: 		local ret = {}
184: 		ret.particle = self:addParticles(Particles.new("dirge_shield", 1))
185: 		
186: 		--Basic effect is in callbacks
187: 		
188: 		upgradeDirgeActivate(self, t, ret)
189: 		game:playSoundNear(self, "talents/chant_three")
190: 		
191: 		return ret
192: 	end,
193: 	deactivate = function(self, t, p)
194: 		self:removeParticles(p.particle)
195: 		
196: 		--Adept Upgrade
197: 		if self:knowTalent(self.T_DIRGE_ADEPT) then
198: 			clearDirges(self)
199: 			local t3 = self:getTalentFromId(self.T_DIRGE_ADEPT)
200: 			self:setEffect(self.EFF_DIRGE_OF_PESTILENCE, t3.getDuration(self, t3), {src=self, shield=t.getShield(self, t), cd=t.getShieldCD(self, t)})
201: 		end
202: 		
203: 		return true
204: 	end,
205: 	info = function(self, t)
206: 		return ([[Sing a song of decay and defiance and sustain yourself through spite.
207: 							Each time you suffer a detrimental effect, you gain a shield with strength %d, that lasts as long as the effect would.  This will add to and extend an existing shield if possible.
208: 							This can only trigger once every %d turns]]):tformat(t.getShield(self, t), t.getShieldCD(self, t))
209: 	end,
210: }
